input: Reflection from this week. The thing I keep coming back to is that I do my best deep work in 90-minute blocks, with a real break in between — not the half-distracted Slack-tab-open kind. When I respect that pattern, my output is 3x what it is on the open-laptop days. Need to defend the calendar more aggressively. Also: I notice I'm at my best in the morning; afternoons are admin time. Don't fight it.
